title: Japan Hunts Ghosts, US Exorcises Demons, Europe Fights Satan: Chinese Taoist Priests Dominate AI Short Dramas
excerpt: A viral AI Taoist priest series has amassed over 170 million total views across global digital platforms, captivating worldwide audiences with its unique core theme of specializing in stopping all kinds of defiance and addressing improper behaviors. This cross-border digital cultural work has broken regional content barriers, leveraging AI-powered creative presentation to deliver distinctive Taoist cultural highlights that resonate with global viewers, quickly becoming a breakout international cultural phenomenon that draws widespread attention from global internet users.
content:
The best exorcists across Europe were wiped out overnight, and the Vatican was also on the verge of collapse. At this critical moment, Europeans finally remembered the only man who could possibly resolve the crisis — Awen, a folk inheritor of Tianshi Taoism and the strongest exorcist on Earth.

You read that right. In today's AI short dramas, Chinese Taoist priests are not only pursuing immortality and cultivating longevity, but also busy fighting evil spirits and eliminating ghosts in Japan, South Korea, Europe and the United States, transforming into superheroes of the new era. Awen is exactly the protagonist of the recently viral AI Taoist short drama *Records of the Unusual and Evil*.

*Records of the Unusual and Evil* tells the fantasy story of Awen, the great Chinese exorcist, and his female apprentice Ayi, who travel all the way to Europe to resolve the Satan crisis. With its novel setting and cinematic-quality shots, *Records of the Unusual and Evil* has gained 51.79 million views on Douyin with only 4 episodes released as of press time.

Since the beginning of this year, the AI short drama circle has launched a variety of popular character settings such as "cute kids", "sassy young girls" and "overseas Chinese students". Now, the "Chinese Taoist priests" who travel overseas in groups are showing a strong momentum to take over the trend.

According to incomplete statistics from the Newrank editorial department, a number of hit AI Taoist-themed short dramas have emerged in the AI short drama circle, including *Ghost Hunters of Ruicao Academy*, *Taoist Priest Comes Down the Mountain: I Fight Evil Spirits in Tokyo*, *Miao Territory Girl Transfer Student*, and *Records of the Unusual and Evil*. Among them, there are more than 7 AI Taoist short dramas with over 50 million views on Douyin.

Different from classic Taoist priest movies such as *Mr. Vampire*, AI Taoist short dramas not only expand the story background to overseas scenes such as Japan, South Korea, Europe and the United States, but also most of the protagonists have a modern and fashionable temperament.

Some of them are handsome young men from Henan who win the heart of Japanese wealthy daughters, some are charismatic uncles who quit the paranormal circle because they are too powerful, some are female ghost hunters who "subdue" handsome men from Japan and South Korea all the way, and some are Miao Territory saintesses who domineeringly rectify weird campuses in Thailand.

Will AI Taoist short dramas become the new traffic code in the AIGC circle? What kind of creative trends lie behind the popularity of AI Taoist priests?

With these questions in mind, the Newrank editorial department recently talked to two creators, "Yang Yu" and "Mao AIGC", about their creative stories.

Note: The Taoist priests mentioned in this article include formally ordained Taoist priests, as well as role settings such as lay Taoist priests, exorcists and ghost hunters. For the convenience of writing, they are collectively referred to as Taoist priests for the time being.

Over 170 million views: AI Taoist priests set off an overseas trend

For "Yang Yu", his original intention to create *Records of the Unusual and Evil* was not to follow the routine of short videos and short dramas, but to produce works with a cinematic feel.

"Yang Yu" revealed that he used to be a musician with a full-time job that paid 18,000 yuan a month and covered food and accommodation. But after Seedance2.5 came out, he realized that if he was one step late, he might completely miss this trend, so he officially resigned in July this year. "It felt like burning my boats."

In October this year, after several rounds of attempts, "Yang Yu" decided to make a work with a more cinematic atmosphere that can match the level of Netflix. "At that time, many Taoist protagonists in the AI short drama circle went to Japan and South Korea, but few went to Europe. I thought it would be better to tell a story about a Chinese person going to Europe to exorcise demons."

The initial inspiration came from a Japanese anime *Blue Exorcist* that "Yang Yu" had watched before. "I really liked that kind of atmosphere, and I wanted to bring it to life."

"Yang Yu" spent a lot of energy polishing the first episode of *Records of the Unusual and Evil*, revising it many times back and forth.

"Yang Yu" set the protagonist as the "exorcism version of One-Punch Man", and integrated a lot of his own personality into the character — "lazy and casual in daily life, but very reliable when things happen". As a southerner, "Yang Yu" also gave the protagonist a distinctive Taiwanese accent.

The protagonist and his apprentice in the drama

In the drama, "Yang Yu" carefully created the climax plot of the fall of European exorcists through details such as statues shedding tears of blood, glowing crosses, successive self-immolations of exorcists, and the sudden appearance of the hell lord.

"At first, some friends thought I was too obsessed with the cinematic feel, but looking back, it has become one of the factors that made *Records of the Unusual and Evil* stand out," "Yang Yu" analyzed.

As of press time, the first episode of *Records of the Unusual and Evil* has received 2.04 million likes on Douyin. A comment with 56,000 likes reads: "AI has completely replaced movies now." Not long ago, a large film and television company also approached "Yang Yu" to discuss possible cooperation.

After the first episode of *Records of the Unusual and Evil* became a hit, "Yang Yu" even urgently asked his Taoist priest friend for tutoring to learn relevant knowledge, hoping to make the male lead's skill settings and fighting methods as reasonable as possible.

However, *Records of the Unusual and Evil* is not the first viral AI Taoist short drama.

As early as the first half of this year, AI Taoist short dramas such as *Tianlu Divination House* and *Longevity Without Taboo* have emerged in the AI short drama circle.

Among them, *Tianlu Divination House* tells the story of Taoist priest Chen Ye, who takes over the Tianlu Divination House left by his master, and takes on paranormal commissions while investigating the truth of his master's disappearance in a cyberpunk city. As of press time, *Tianlu Divination House* has gained 90.57 million views on Douyin alone.

But the AI Taoist short dramas that emerged in batches in the second half of this year are likely derived from the previously viral AI overseas Chinese student short dramas.

In August this year, with the popularity of *Pretty Malice*, overseas Chinese students whose ancestral homes are in Sichuan, Henan, Shandong and other places appeared in Japan and South Korea in short dramas. To create differentiation, the characters of these overseas Chinese students are diverse: some are silly young masters whose financial resources crush South Korean chaebols, some have super combat power and can fight ten people at once.

But the character setting routines will eventually be exhausted, so some creators began to raise the stakes for the "overseas Chinese students".

On September 5, "Pang Miao Bu Pang" began to update *Taoist Priest Comes Down the Mountain: I Fight Evil Spirits in Tokyo*. It also tells the story of a Chinese overseas student going abroad as an exchange student, except that the protagonist has another identity: a Taoist priest.

*Taoist Priest Comes Down the Mountain: I Fight Evil Spirits in Tokyo* mainly tells the story of Zhang Xuanyi, a Taoist priest from Mount Longhu, who goes to Japan as an exchange student and meets the Japanese wealthy daughter Kamiyo Rin. He accidentally discovers that she is about to be sacrificed by her family and is destined to not live past 25. So Zhang Xuanyi falls in love with Kamiyo Rin playfully while fighting against evil Japanese forces to save Kamiyo Rin from her tragic fate.

It not only retains the popular setting of Chinese overseas students being exchange students abroad, but also expands the story from campus to the mysterious fantasy world through the identity of Taoist priest, giving full play to AI's advantages in creating grand scenes, making the first episode of *Taoist Priest Comes Down the Mountain: I Fight Evil Spirits in Tokyo* get 390,000 likes on Douyin.

As of press time, *Taoist Priest Comes Down the Mountain: I Fight Evil Spirits in Tokyo* has gained 61.1 million views on Douyin alone.

A similar work is *Ghost Hunters of Ruicao Academy* by "Hong Taotao", which mainly tells the story of Long Yang, the 19th generation ghost hunter of the Long clan in Miao Territory, who uses his identity as an exchange student to trace the source of resentment, eliminate ghosts and "subdue" handsome men from Japan and South Korea.

With well-modeled and distinctive male characters, plus mysterious but not scary ghost hunting elements, *Ghost Hunters of Ruicao Academy* has accumulated 170 million views on Douyin.

The exotic style and beautiful romantic plots similar to AI overseas Chinese student short dramas, plus the newly added mysterious Taoist priest elements, have become the core features of this type of AI Taoist short dramas.

But perhaps because the romance track is too saturated, and it cannot give full play to AI's visual advantages, some creators began to draw materials from superhero movies, taking modern action adventure as the core label, and created a number of AI Taoist short dramas with the core selling point of "Chinese Taoist priests beating overseas demons and ghosts", such as *Records of the Unusual and Evil*, *American Taoist Priest*, and *Post-Dharma Outer Record: European Exorcism Chronicles*.

The behind-the-scenes creator of "Mao AIGC" is a UI designer. In October this year, after trying many AI Taoist short dramas in the style of old Hong Kong films such as *New Black Cat Taoist Priest* and *My Master Fengjiao*, he decided to make a different one.

"I have watched a lot of Taoist-themed works since I was a child, and I am good at creating this type of theme. At that time, I saw many Taoist protagonists going abroad, so I wanted to let the protagonist go to the United States to explore."

Thus, *American Taoist Priest*, which tells the story of a Chinese Taoist priest going to the United States to deal with vampires and werewolves, was born. To increase the fun, "Mao AIGC" also designed a supporting character who is a Sino-American mixed-race, speaks with a strong Northeast Chinese accent, and can be possessed by a fox fairy.

该文观点仅代表作者本人，36氪平台仅提供信息存储空间服务。
